text: のうりょくを　さげさせれば　しょうぶも　ゆうりに　なるじゃろう

structure.jp: のうりょくを　さげさせれば
structure.en: if you make its stats drop

structure.jp: しょうぶも　ゆうりに　なるじゃろう
structure.en: the battle will probably turn in your favor

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば on the end of a verb means 'if'. さげさせれば = 'if you make it go down'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means making someone do it. さげさせる = 'make it lower (its stats)'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう says something is probably so; じゃろう is the old-man way of saying it. なるじゃろう = 'it will probably become'.
